subject: sounds
title: Blend the sounds
about: Hear the sounds of a word one at a time and tap the word they make, including words with consonant blends like fl and st. This is NC RF.1.3.b and the oral blending drill CKLA uses every day.
tip: If the voice garbles a sound, say the sounds yourself slowly (kuh ... ah ... t), then let him pick.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: c - a - t?
cards.sayQ: Listen. kuh, ah, tuh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: s - u - n?
cards.sayQ: Listen. sss, uh, nnn. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: m - a - p?
cards.sayQ: Listen. mmm, ah, puh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: p - i - g?
cards.sayQ: Listen. puh, ih, guh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: b - e - d?
cards.sayQ: Listen. buh, eh, duh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: h - u - g?
cards.sayQ: Listen. huh, uh, guh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: sh - i - p?
cards.sayQ: Listen. shh, ih, puh. What word is that?
cards.note: sh - i - p makes ship. The sh is one sound.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: ch - i - n?
cards.sayQ: Listen. chuh, ih, nnn. What word is that?
cards.note: ch - i - n makes chin. The ch is one sound.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: f - i - sh?
cards.sayQ: Listen. fff, ih, shh. What word is that?
cards.note: f - i - sh makes fish. The sh is one sound.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: j - e - t?
cards.sayQ: Listen. juh, eh, tuh. What word is that?

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: f - l - a - g?
cards.sayQ: Listen. fff, lll, ah, guh. What word is that?
cards.note: f - l - a - g makes flag. The f and l are two sounds that blend together.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: s - t - e - p?
cards.sayQ: Listen. sss, tuh, eh, puh. What word is that?
cards.note: s - t - e - p makes step. The s and t are two sounds that blend together.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: d - r - u - m?
cards.sayQ: Listen. duh, rrr, uh, mmm. What word is that?
cards.note: d - r - u - m makes drum. The d and r are two sounds that blend together.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: s - n - a - p?
cards.sayQ: Listen. sss, nnn, ah, puh. What word is that?
cards.note: s - n - a - p makes snap. The s and n are two sounds that blend together.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: c - r - a - b?
cards.sayQ: Listen. kuh, rrr, ah, buh. What word is that?
cards.note: c - r - a - b makes crab. The c and r are two sounds that blend together.

cards.q: What word do these sounds make: j - u - m - p?
cards.sayQ: Listen. juh, uh, mmm, puh. What word is that?
cards.note: j - u - m - p makes jump. The m and p at the end are two sounds that blend together.
